deb_decimal -> deb_lsd c(dec1, lsd1, lsd2) #> <deb_lsd[5]> #> [1] 5:10s:6d   12:4s:8.4d 8:9s:0d    3:13s:4d   8:15s:9d   #> # Bases: 20s 12d # deb_decimal -> deb_tetra c(dec1, tetra1, 8.25) #> <deb_tetra[5]> #> [1] 5:10s:6d:0f   12:4s:8d:1.6f 8:9s:0d:0f    3:13s:4d:3f   8:5s:0d:0f    #> # Bases: 20s 12d 4f # deb_decimal -> deb_tetra -> deb_lsd c(dec1, tetra1, lsd2) #> <deb_lsd[5]> #> [1] 5:10s:6d    12:4s:8.4d  8:9s:0d     3:13s:4.75d 8:15s:9d    #> # Bases: 20s 12d  # Cast between deb_lsd, deb_tetra, and deb_decimal vectors deb_as_lsd(dec1) #> <deb_lsd[3]> #> [1] 5:10s:6d   12:4s:8.4d 8:9s:0d    #> #
